caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic plate with a brownish-yellow base color, featuring a central decorative motif. The main design on the plate consists of a green, heart-shaped vase or pot from which brown and green stems extend upward and outward. The stems branch into multiple directions and end in abstract leaf and flower shapes with touches of purple, green, and brown. Surrounding the central motif, there are additional smaller, loosely drawn floral and leaf elements in similar colors. The rim of the plate is outlined in brown, and there are areas of lighter green and yellow shading within the decoration. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color. A signature is present near the lower right section of the plate's outline.
title: Pa. German Pie Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
